public_health_question.v: Should ACIP expand preexposure Ebola vaccination recommendations to health care personnel at SPTCs and laboratorians at LRN facilities, and how acceptable is vaccination to them?

ev.q: This policy note reviews the expansion of these recommendations to include two additional populations
The purpose of the survey was to measure EVD vaccine acceptability and sentiments in these populations.
Use of Ebola Vaccine: Expansion of Recommendations of the Advisory Committee on Immunization Practices To Include Two Additional Populations

notes: Vaccine efficacy and safety evidence comes from GRADE profiles presented at an earlier ACIP meeting; these are cited, not computed here. The report's own quantities are KAP survey percentages, which are set side by side across populations and vaccination scenarios with no contrast computed.
view_issues: The text says 58 LRN laboratories can test for Ebola virus, but 62 LRN facilities were identified at the time of the survey.
